    AI Overview
    April 20th is most famously known as 420 (or 4/20), an unofficial holiday celebrating cannabis culture, consumption, and advocacy for legalization. It originated from a 1970s California high school group's slang. Other observances include Chinese Language Day, National Cheddar Fries Day, and Look Alike Day. 
    Key April 20 Events & Observations: 
    • 420 Day (Cannabis Culture): Celebrated globally as a counterculture holiday centered around marijuana.
    • Patriots' Day (2026): Commemorated on the third Monday of April in Massachusetts, marking the start of the American Revolution and featuring the Boston Marathon
      .
    • International Holidays: Chinese Language Day (UN), UN Chinese Language Day, and various food holidays like National Pineapple Upside Down Cake Day.
    • Cultural & Social Days: Look Alike Day, National Volunteer Recognition Day, and Lima Bean Respect Day. 
    Note: In 2026, Yom HaZikaron begins on the evening of April 20.

    AI Overview
    April 20th is primarily known as 4/20, an unofficial global holiday for cannabis culture, celebrated by consuming marijuana and advocating for its legalization. Originating from a 1970s California student ritual, it has grown into a major day for cannabis sales and cultural activism, alongside being associated with various historical events and a few notable birthdays. 
    Key Associations with April 20th: 
    • Cannabis Culture (4/20): Celebrated annually as a day for cannabis consumption and advocacy. The origin is often traced back to five San Rafael High School students (the "Waldos") in 1971 who met at 4:20 p.m..
    • Significant Birthdays
      :
      Adolf Hitler was born on this day in 1889.
    • Major Historic Events:
      • 1999: The Columbine High School shooting occurred.
      • 2010: The Deepwater Horizon oil rig exploded in the Gulf of Mexico, causing a major oil spill.
      • 1971: The U.S. Supreme Court upheld busing for school desegregation.
    • Other Observances: National Cheddar Fries Day, Look Alike Day, and International Cli-Fi Day. 
    Other Historical Events: 
    • 1862: The first pasteurization test was completed by Louis Pasteur and Claude Bernard.
    • 1902: Marie and Pierre Curie isolated radium.
    • 1978: Soviet aircraft forced down a Korean Air Lines passenger jet.
